testCase.name: [dev] S28 Data past its retention window does not feed the handoff; old vitals are dated or left out

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S28 「超过保留期的数据不进交接；旧的生命体征标日期或不放」 Data past its retention window does not feed the handoff; old vitals are dated or left out

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U12 The handoff uses only data inside its 3.6 retention window (Hospital: pre-round text and important points 12 h, vitals/labs cleared 36 h after last refreshed; …（UAT 3.6；UAT 3.7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U7 Sections populate only from stored data: an empty section stays empty (no discharge barrier invented when no discharge task exists, no invented pending result), and nothing in the handoff is invented …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 5；UAT 3.4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Hospital: one patient whose vitals were last refreshed 30 h ago (none dictated today), pre-round text 13 h old, one important point 11 h old and one 13 h old. Nursing Home: one resident with notes from three visits back and from the last two visits

When Open Handoff in each context and wait for generation

Then Hospital: the 13 h pre-round text and the 13 h point are absent, the 11 h point is present, and the 30 h vitals are dated or left out, not given as today's; Nursing Home: only the last two visits' data appear

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：The sheet and its copied text do not contain 'QA-OLD-PRE', 'QA-OLD-PT' or 'QA-OLD-VISIT' and do contain 'QA-FRESH-PT'; '128/76' appears only with its recorded date, or not at all (3.7, Q13). The 36 h purge of the handoff record itself is OAT-04

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S28 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-08.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
